evidence: Seed row 135 is Princess R35, marked historical with a 2018 launch.
Official launch notice: https://www.princess.co.uk/news/the-all-new-princess-r35
Official R Class brochure supplies the R35 dimensions and Volvo Petrol V8/duo-prop stern-drive configuration: https://www.princess.fr/media-file/2399/r-class-brochure-2019-20-book-1.pdf
Independent Soundings coverage identifies the same carbon-fibre R35, twin 430-hp Volvo Penta gasoline inboards and 50-knot claim: https://soundingsonline.com/boats/princess-yachts-r35/
The seed's twin-petrol-outboards wording and incomplete beam/draft fields are spec defects, not evidence of a different R35 generation.
Seed row 67 is Princess V40 with dimensions, tanks, engines and 34–36-knot performance matching the official V40 specification.

Current official V40 page still identifies the 2017 launch and publishes the same 12.98 m, 3.81 m, 0.56/1.02 m, 9,592 kg, 730 L and D6-380 values: https://www.princessyachts.com/our-yachts/v-class/v40/

Seed row 64's 17.81 m / 4.65 m / 1.44 m dimensions, 28,589 kg displacement, 2,500/466/300 L tanks, D13-1000 engines and 33–35-knot band match the official current V55 page.
Official 2019 release describes the all-new V55, three cabins for six and the drop-down patio door: https://www.princess.co.uk/news/the-new-princess-v55-the-heart-and-soul-of-the-v-class
Official current specification: https://www.princessyachts.com/our-yachts/v-class/v55/

The independent draft is approximately 1.40 m and the launch claim reached 37 knots; these are recorded conflicts, not substitutions for the official 1.44 m and current 33–35-knot fields.
Seed row 57 matches the official F45 dimensions, displacement, tanks, IPS650 engines and 29–31-knot performance.

Seed row 52 matches the official F65 dimensions, 37,253 kg displacement, 4,100/802/272 L tanks, V8-1200 engines and 31–33-knot band.

Motor Boat & Yachting reports a 5.10 m beam and 1.48 m draft in show-tour metadata; the draft conflict is retained rather than used to remap the model: https://www.mby.com/boat-shows-and-events/southampton-boat-show/2022-princess-f65-122771
